system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: It reads the project's own `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` plus a global one you set once, runs a lean coding prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Closed source; README prose only. Memory index and per-model LLM Profile hints also injected.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: a repo map so it heads straight to the right file in a large codebase, `@` to point at a file by name
env_context_strategy.note: Repo map plus Read/Grep tools in Code session log; prose only.

context_compaction.note: Closed source; repo is a v7 snapshot not included in bundle file tree; no config surface available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Computer Use takes screenshots, clicks, types and scrolls, with approval on every action in Safety Mode, and the screenshots appear inline in chat.
observation_format.note: Browser agent uses 'semantic element detection through the accessibility tree'.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code in bundle; LLM Profiles mention tool calls but not format.

tool_count.note: README claims 260+ tools but no default tool list available to count.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tool exists ('Edit') but its primitive is not described.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Add MCP servers for anything else.
tool_schema_source.note: Native tool schema source not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Skales also speaks Agent2Agent, so another agent can discover this instance and delegate to it.
protocol_standardization.note: MCP servers also supported per README.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ReAct agent loop, 260+ tools, multi-agent delegation, per-turn tool budgeting
loop_primitives.note: /goal plans steps then runs them; default chat is ReAct.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **Goals** shows what each one is trying to do, the criteria it must meet and the evidence it has collected, its last steps with the tool each used

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Parallel sub-agents show in a rail with live token and tool-call counts and a Stop all.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default chat single agent; sub-agents, Organization (CEO routing, hierarchical), Group Chat reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Parallel sub-agents show in a rail with live token and tool-call counts and a Stop all.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Plan** investigates and proposes, **Code** asks before each edit, **Edits** approves file edits as it goes but still asks before a shell command or a push, **Auto** runs the whole task after a one-time consent.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the criteria it must meet and the evidence it has collected

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Short-term and long-term memory, identity maintenance, and a three-phase overnight consolidation engine (Dreaming) that promotes what matters and discards noise
long_term_memory.note: Obsidian vault notes, SKILL.md skills, local embedding history search.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Reopen the app and it picks up where it left off.

self_verification.note: Goal success criteria mentioned, mechanism not described.

rollback.evidence_quote: one-click Undo per file or for a whole turn
rollback.note: User-invoked undo; git diffs also shown; Keep/Revert in review panel.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: it stops when the task is done, when it genuinely needs a decision, or before a consequential action

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Skales matches a per-model profile that tunes the tool budget, prompt size and a short per-model hint
cost_controls.note: Per-turn tool budgeting; /spin model choice. Mapping approximate.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Not in a browser tab, not behind a restrictive API, not in a complex Docker container. It sits on your machine

permission_model.evidence_quote: before a consequential action like sending an email, where it asks once with a one-tap always-allow
permission_model.note: Mode-dependent; Auto mode after one-time consent.

replayability.evidence_quote: a repeatable run can be recorded as a **Playbook** and replayed later

guardrails.evidence_quote: every plugin runs against an explicit tool list, locked to its own folder, and anything that leaves the machine still asks first
guardrails.note: Watermark character stripping and Privacy Mode as output filters.

target_domain.evidence_quote: coding (Skales Code), desktop + browser automation, autonomous scheduled Tasks

open_source.evidence_quote: Skales itself is closed source under BSL 1.1
open_source.note: BSL 1.1 not OSI; v7 snapshot historically present.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: No vendor lock-in. Bring your own key, or run locally for free.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This is where Skales is *distributed*: releases, the changelog, install guides and the issue tracker.
primary_artifact.note: Coded from README only; product source closed.
